summary: Your second teach-back. You write what you know, explain Depends() and constructor injection in 5 sentences or a voice note, check six key points, and build both with a small SummaryService to see the difference.
goal: Explain in 5 sentences how Depends() and constructor injection differ and work together.

items.text: Write one line for dependency, constructor and Depends(), plus one thing you are unsure about
Explain the difference in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note, without notes
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Build SummaryService, call it by hand, test it alone, then add the Depends provider and see your tests pass
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap and compare with your Day 13 teach-back
Play the Injection Quiz game to the end and see your score
